spec.expr:
WITH (
  pv = label_set(
    sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_pv_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month) / 1000,
    "series",
    "PV"
  ),
  gridImport = label_set(
    sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_grid_import_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month) / 1000,
    "series",
    "Import réseau"
  ),
  home = label_set(
    sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month) * -1 / 1000,
    "series",
    "Maison"
  ),
  loadpoints = label_copy(
    sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",loadpoint!~"$loadpointBlocklist"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month, loadpoint) * -1 / 1000,
    "loadpoint",
    "series"
  ),
  gridExport = label_set(
    sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_grid_export_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month) * -1 / 1000,
    "series",
    "Injection"
  )
)
pv or gridImport or home or loadpoints or gridExport

spec.title: Rendement spécifique
spec.description: Rendement PV annuel normalise par kWc installe. Utilise les valeurs watt_peak des actifs d investissement si disponibles, sinon installedWattPeak.

spec.expr:
WITH (
  gridImport = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_grid_import_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))),
  homeEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))),
  loadpointEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d])) or vector(0))
)
clamp_max(clamp_min(1 - gridImport / clamp_min(homeEnergy + loadpointEnergy, 0.001), 0), 1)

WITH (
  pvEnergy = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_pv_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))),
  gridExport = running_sum(sum(last_over_time(evcc_grid_export_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d])))
)
clamp_max(clamp_min((pvEnergy - gridExport) / clamp_min(pvEnergy, 0.001), 0), 1)

WITH (
  greenShare = sum(last_over_time(evcc_green_share_home_daily_ratio{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d])),
  sumGreenShare = running_sum(greenShare),
  countGreenShare = running_sum((greenShare * 0) + 1)
)
sumGreenShare / clamp_min(countGreenShare, 1)

WITH (
  gridImport = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_grid_import_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  homeEnergy = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  loadpointEnergy = (sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) or (homeEnergy * 0),
  pvEnergy = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_pv_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  gridExport = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_grid_export_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  greenShareSum = sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_green_share_home_daily_ratio{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  greenShareCount = sum(count_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_green_share_home_daily_ratio{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month),
  autarky = label_set(1 - gridImport / clamp_min(homeEnergy + loadpointEnergy, 0.001), "series", "Autarcie"),
  selfConsumption = label_set((pvEnergy - gridExport) / pvEnergy, "series", "Autoconsommation"),
  greenShare = label_set(greenShareSum / clamp_min(greenShareCount, 1), "series", "Part verte")
)
autarky or selfConsumption or greenShare

WITH (
  other = label_set((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month) - sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_ext_energy_daily_wh{title!="",title!~"$extBlocklist",local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) / 1000, "series", "Autre"),
  ext = label_copy((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_ext_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",title!="",title!~"$extBlocklist"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month, title)) / 1000, "title", "series"),
  aux = label_copy((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_aux_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",title!="",title!~"$auxBlocklist"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month, title)) / 1000, "title", "series")
)
other or ext or aux

WITH (
  batteryNet = ((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_battery_charge_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) - (sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_battery_discharge_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month))) / 1000,
  batteryCharge = label_set((batteryNet > 0), "series", "Charge batterie"),
  batteryDischarge = label_set((batteryNet < 0), "series", "Décharge batterie"),
  home = label_set((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_home_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month)) / 1000, "series", "Maison"),
  loadpoints = label_copy((sum(sum_over_time((last_over_time(evcc_loadpoint_energy_daily_wh{local_year="${__from:date:YYYY}",loadpoint!~"$loadpointBlocklist"}[1d]))[$__range:1d])) by (local_month, loadpoint)) / 1000, "loadpoint", "series")
)
home or sort_by_label(loadpoints, "series") or batteryCharge or batteryDischarge

spec.title: Véhicules
spec.description: La consommation n’est pertinente qu’après plusieurs mois. La charge externe est ignorée et fausse le résultat.

spec.title: Kilomètres mensuels
spec.description: Les kilomètres ne sont relevés que lorsqu’un véhicule est branché. S’il est branché rarement, des kilomètres peuvent manquer.

spec.title: Consommation (kWh/100km)
spec.description: Les valeurs sont approximatives. La charge externe n’est pas incluse et les kilomètres relevés dépendent de la fréquence de branchement du véhicule.

spec.title: Coûts de production PV
spec.description: Coût annuel de production PV basé sur l investissement par source PV plus total pondéré. Les valeurs avec moins de 1 kWh d énergie PV annuelle mappée sont omises. Les coûts de batterie et de réseau ne sont pas inclus.

spec.title: Coût de production PV/semaine (ct/kWh)
spec.description: Coût de production PV glissant sur 7 jours par source PV. Les valeurs ne sont affichées que si la fenêtre de 7 jours contient plus de 1 kWh d énergie PV mappée. Les coûts de batterie et de réseau ne sont pas inclus.

spec.title: Rendement specifique PV (kWh/kWc)
spec.description: Rendement PV annuel par source, normalise par kWc installe. Les valeurs sont generees par l assistant investissement depuis l energie PV mappee et les metadonnees watt_peak; le panneau de l annee selectionnee inclut les annees partielles avec la couverture dans la legende.

spec.title: Rendement specifique PV/semaine (kWh/kWc)
spec.description: Rendement PV glissant sur 7 jours normalise par kWc installe et par source PV. Les valeurs sont generees par l assistant investissement et affichees seulement si la fenetre de 7 jours contient plus de 1 kWh d energie PV mappee.
